Recipe.title: Classic Margherita Pizza
Recipe.description: Neapolitan-style pizza with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
Recipe.ingredients: Pizza dough, San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, basil, olive oil, salt.
Recipe.instructions: Stretch the dough, top sparingly, bake at the highest oven setting on a hot stone for 6-8 minutes.

Recipe.title: Kung Pao Chicken
Recipe.description: Stir-fried chicken with peanuts and dried chilies in a savory-sweet sauce.
Recipe.ingredients: Chicken thigh, peanuts, dried chilies, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar.
Recipe.instructions: Velvet the chicken, stir-fry aromatics and chilies, add chicken and sauce, finish with peanuts.

Recipe.title: Street Tacos al Pastor
Recipe.description: Marinated pork tacos with pineapple and cilantro.
Recipe.ingredients: Pork shoulder, achiote paste, pineapple, corn tortillas, onion, cilantro, lime.
Recipe.instructions: Marinate the pork overnight, sear thin slices, chop and serve on warm tortillas with pineapple and cilantro.

Recipe.title: Chana Masala
Recipe.description: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato-onion gravy.
Recipe.ingredients: Chickpeas, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, garam masala.
Recipe.instructions: Saute onion and spices, add tomato and chickpeas, simmer until the gravy thickens.

Recipe.title: Coq au Vin
Recipe.description: Chicken braised slowly in red wine with mushrooms and bacon.
Recipe.ingredients: Chicken, red wine, lardons, pearl onions, mushrooms, thyme, bay leaf.
Recipe.instructions: Brown the chicken and lardons, braise with wine and aromatics for 45 minutes, reduce the sauce.

Review.comment: Best pizza crust in town, blistered and chewy.
Great pasta, a bit slow on a busy Friday.
Dim sum on Sunday morning is the move.
